questions.q: What effect does recalling traumatic memories have on the brain?
a: Raises blood pressure and deactivates rational thinking
Increases heart rate and improves memory
Reduces stress hormones and boosts mood
questions.why: Recalled trauma raises blood pressure and deactivates rational brain areas.

questions.q: Which therapy uses a finger movement and audio cues to help trauma patients?
questions.why: EMDR involves following a moving finger with audio cues.

questions.q: What common coping method does the book say is only a temporary fix for trauma?
questions.why: The text notes drugs, alcohol, or overworking are temporary fixes.

questions.q: Which practice helps reconnect body and mind according to the book?
questions.why: Yoga is cited as connecting mind and body.

questions.q: What is the main goal of mindfulness in trauma recovery?
a: Become aware of body and emotions
questions.why: Mindfulness aims to mentally connect with body and emotions.
